title: Keyword search on Polymarket public-search missed both CCT SA semifinal events that already existed; direct slug/tag reads found them
detail: At 14:31-14:33Z this session queried gamma-api public-search findings were superseded by direct slug queries: event 1249731 (cs2-tdkg-yaw-2026-10-25, created 2026-10-25T01:55:12Z, outcomes 'Tropa do KinGui'/'Yawara Esports', eventStartTime 19:00:00Z) and event 1248800 (cs2-chama-reda-2026-10-25, created 2026-10-24T21:45:12Z, outcomes 'BORRACHEIROS'/'RED Canids Academy', eventStartTime 16:00:00Z) both predate the 13:44-13:46Z keyword searches that reported no Oct 25 semifinal market. Keyword search orders by relevance/volume and surfaces older closed events first; it must never be used as proof that no market exists. The collector's tag/slug enumeration and direct events?slug= queries are the verified path. Recorded so future sessions do not repeat the 'no market yet' conclusion from a keyword search alone.

title: 1086697 cannot be priced by the Valve standings rung: no rating row exists for Projeto do KinGui/Tropa do KinGui in the official files
detail: First-hand read of ValveSoftware/counter-strike_regional_standings live/2026/standings_global_2026_10_05.md (the file scripts/originate.py reads): Yawara is present (rank 147, rating 845) but a case-insensitive search returns zero rows for KinGui/Projeto do KinGui/Tropa do KinGui in either the global or Americas file; the alias-evidence roster has dispersed (CutzMeretz now on MEIA NOITE #227, t9rnay on EHISTO BASE #224). model_estimate therefore correctly returns 'no Valve rating row found' rather than inventing a rating. The fixture's published pick came instead from the complete-layer consensus rung after Polymarket event 1249731 opened (65.1/34.9, median of 2 books, observed 14:23Z). If both consensus books ever become unavailable, this fixture must fall to a labelled HLTV-rank/bo3.gg rung or the unresolved register - never to a placeholder. HLTV team 13151 shows world ranking '-' (peak #164), so a world-ranking rung has no numerical input either.

detail: Re-read of the deployed executive summary at 14:33Z shows row 15 'HOTU 98.2% / The Huns 1.8% Researched' with no featured market line - the complete-layer estimate replacing an expired/weakened line, exactly the case 0DB0-R03 flags as extreme and uncalibrated. title: Polymarket 1249433 rule text says '3:00 PM ET' (19:00Z wording) while its machine timestamps say 18:00Z matching Hotspawn
detail: Event 1249433 (paiN vs BESTIA, 1082697) description says 'initially scheduled for October 25, 2026 at 3:00 PM ET' (= 19:00Z) but eventStartTime/gameStartTime are both 2026-10-25T18:00:00Z and Hotspawn schedules the fixture at 18:00Z; the published pick (paiN 58.5/41.5) bound the 18:00Z machine timestamps as the join key. The same sentence pattern appears on event 1249731 (initially scheduled 3:00 PM ET) whose eventStartTime is 19:00Z = Hotspawn exactly - so the ET sentence is not a reliable schedule source anywhere in this event family. Join rule: machine timestamps only; the prose mismatch is recorded here for manual review, never smoothed over.
